shared_elements: human head with schematic facial features
raised/abstracted rendering of human form in relief or sculpture
justification: Both depict the human form in a highly schematic manner \u2014 A shows a frieze of small figures with raised arms interacting with animals, B is a single large head with reduced, ridge-like brows and elongated nose. The correspondence stops at 'humans depicted schematically': A is a multi-figure narrative band with animals and gestures of grasping, while B is an isolated frontal head with no scene, no companions and no relationships between elements.
